scientific_integrity: Exact proof based on incidence decomposition; independent finite-case kernel checks; no third-party formal audit or claimed priority. The negative-type cutoff alone is acknowledged as a direct spectral consequence of known Kneser eigenvalue theory.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge vertex graph metric on KG(n,2), n>=5. Kernel exp(-t*d^p), t,p>0. Critical-window asymptotic for each fixed c>1; no assertion for KG(n,k), k>2, nor uniformity in unbounded c.
title: A sharp bandwidth phase transition for Kneser pair-metric exponential kernels
